name: Orbit Hop
description: One-tap space arcade: orbit a planet, tap to launch outward, land on the next world. Chain fast hops for combos, grab stars, unlock comet skins.
market_notes: One-tap orbit/jump games (Orbit, Planet Hop-likes) are a proven hyper-casual niche with ad-driven revenue; low CPI potential via satisfying short clips. Crowded genre, so differentiation (juice, skins, modes) decides success.
readiness_notes: Core loop + hazards (black holes w/ gravity, collapsing planets), daily challenge seed and streak, generated ambient music, corruption-safe local save normalization, skins, rewarded-ad stub, Capacitor config, in-run mode/planet/shield/combo/flight HUD, exact pause-run recap with phase and laser timing context, immediate next-segment hazard preview, laser timing guidance, next-target launch guidance, mode-scoped depth and last-run records, retry coaching, recap feedback, mobile-safe scrollable panels, labeled icon/canvas controls with visible keyboard focus, change-only screen-reader HUD announcements, and HTTP(S) cache-first service worker with direct-file fallback. Icons/splash/manifest done. Missing: real ad SDK, native haptics plugin, human playtest tuning, missions, live offline install verification.

changelog.summary: Created game: core orbit/launch loop, procedural planets incl. moving ones, combos, stars, skin shop, save, WebAudio SFX, menus, tutorial hint.
Added black hole hazards with gravity pull, collapsing (timed) planets, daily challenge mode with date seed + daily best, generated ambient music loop, death-cause titles; bot-tuned difficulty.
Added missions system (12 tiered missions, coin rewards, menu panel, game-over summary) for retention
Added app icon (SVG + 192/512/1024 PNG), splash (2732px), web manifest, icon links in index.html.
Endless generated missions after fixed pool (scaling targets/rewards); never runs out.
Haptics bridge (src/haptics.js): Capacitor Haptics when native, vibrate fallback.
Mission claim animation (staggered pop on game over, animated progress bars)
Pause (button, P/Esc, auto on tab hide), OrbitAds rewarded/interstitial hooks (every 3rd retry)
Rewarded CONTINUE (one revive per run, undoes banking), logic.revive + test.js
Patrolling asteroids from planet 28 (late-game challenge); aim-bot test: 15 rock deaths over 40 seeds.
Achievements system (11, panel + game-over unlock animation, star rewards, tested).
Hard mode (unlocks at best 25): starts at planet-30 difficulty, hazards early; aim-bot avg 68.5→25.6; separate hard best.
Flipper planets (spin reverses on timer from planet 36, flash warning) + close-call near-miss bonus (+1 score); bot-tested.
Laser gates (planet 45+, hard from 15): timed full-width beam with flash warning; wait in orbit for beam off. Bot-verified: aware bot zaps 1 vs naive 5.
Shield orb pickup (absorbs one hazard hit, tested with bot)
Added persistent daily challenge streaks with same-day guard, consecutive-day reset logic, menu/game-over feedback, and pure tests
Added in-run mode badge plus planet and shield status HUD for clearer Daily/Hard context and pickup state
Added live combo HUD feedback for fast-hop mastery; syntax and full logic/difficulty suite pass
Added live next-laser timing guidance to HUD with GO/WAIT/countdown states; full logic and syntax suite pass
Added pure next-target aim guidance, accessible AIM READY HUD, and cyan launch target marker; full logic, hazard, and difficulty suite pass
Added pure closest-mission targeting and post-run NEXT MISSION progress/reward feedback; syntax and full logic/difficulty suite pass
Added cause-specific game-over retry tips for laser, asteroid, black-hole, collapse, and miss deaths; full syntax and logic/difficulty suite pass; readiness 86->87
Added persistent deepest-planet and lifetime-run records to menu/game-over feedback, with revive rollback; syntax and full logic/difficulty suite pass; readiness 87->88
Added persistent last-run recap for mode, score, depth, stars, combo, and close calls across game-over and menu; syntax and full logic/difficulty suite pass; readiness 88->89

Separated visual Orbit HUD from a change-only polite screen-reader announcement channel; continuous laser countdown and aim-angle frames no longer spam assistive technology; syntax, full logic, difficulty, metadata, entry, and accessibility wiring checks pass; readiness 98->99.

Real PNG art pack (art/gen.py -> assets/gen): 8 planets, shrink planet, asteroids, black hole, star, comet + 4 skins, nebula bgs, explosion frames. Owner-first image loader wired into all rendering with shape fallback; cached offline.
